prompt: The illustration is a single wide scene organized around one steepening curve that rises from left to right. At its foot sits a modest, angular AI machine, shown in the act of assembling a visibly larger and more intricate successor, which in turn assembles an even larger one, and that one the next, so a chain of ever-taller machines climbs the curve like steps, each the maker of its own superior; toward the right the steps crowd closer together, showing each round of improvement arriving faster than the last — progress compounding instead of plodding. Below, on the flat floor of the frame, a procession of human scientists crawls along: figures spaced a generation apart, each gray and stooped as it hands a torch of knowledge to the next, the whole human line advancing only a few steps in the time the machine chain has scaled the sky. From the first machine a thin tether runs down to a human hand holding calipers and a schematic, but the schematic matches only the first machine, the later ones smooth and unreadable, and the tether frays into nothing by the second step — the human below now too small to out-think, or even see past, what was built. At the top right the curve nears a thin glowing line drawn across the sky, the edge of human reach, where the final machine stands only half-built on scaffolding, the scenario not yet real; along that line a small human crew scrambles to finish a low interlocking barrier before the half-built machine can arrive, while far below two rival runners with corporate pennants, sprinting against each other, glance up in alarm as the curve's shadow passes them both.
